semiconductor_relevance: High — CMK specializes in the production of high-purity gallium and gallium arsenide, which are critical materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: CMK is a leader in the production of high-purity gallium and gallium arsenide, utilizing advanced technologies for crystal growth and recycling. The company emphasizes sustainable manufacturing through an integrated in-house system that manages the entire production process, including the development of encapsulants and recycling technologies.
capabilities: Production of high-purity boron oxide (B₂O₃) encapsulants

regional_presence.Czech Republic: CMK has a historical presence in gallium production, with significant developments in the region since 1967.
